message: Review fix requires updating existing replaceBudgetBatch callers in backend/src/warehouse/{composed-relation.db.test.ts,gl-month-rollups.db.test.ts,golden-financial.db.test.ts,selection-slice.db.test.ts}; they are outside statement-model write_scope, and leaving them unchanged makes build:backend fail or preserves the forbidden optional snapshot path.

notes: AUTHORIZED - mechanically implied by making the outline argument required. The four gated proofs call replaceBudgetBatch with two arguments, so the signature change forces them; leaving them out would either break build:backend or keep the forbidden optional-snapshot path alive, which is the blocking finding itself. Adapt ONLY the call site in each - pass the outline the test's own fixture implies - and change NO assertion, because those six proofs passing UNCHANGED in substance is decision 0022's promise that the (gl_code, month) relation was not disturbed. Recorded on the stage with amend-scope.

message: statement-api must extend contract/src/measure.ts because DomainSpec.composed.joinKeys is hard-coded to gl_code/month while decision 0022 requires the registered statement domain to declare leaf_key/month; using gl_code would make the semantic contract false

notes: AUTHORIZED - mechanically implied, and verified: contract/src/measure.ts:59 types joinKeys as the literal tuple ['gl_code', 'month'], so a statement_relation domain joining on leaf_key cannot be declared at all without widening it. Registering that domain is this task's FIRST acceptance criterion, so the type is not optional scope. Widen joinKeys to accept the statement grain (a readonly string tuple, or a union that admits ['leaf_key','month']) WITHOUT loosening it into plain string[] - the literal type is what stops a domain declaring a join the builder cannot honour, and decision 0022 keeps the (gl_code, month) relation intact, so the existing composed domain must still type-check unchanged. Recorded on the stage with amend-scope.
